title: True Nitwit VIllager
description: Make the Nitwit villagers look like how they act.
body:
## 🤪 Nitwits Finally Look the Part

Nitwit villagers shouldn't look this normal while being so useless.

This resource pack gives **True Nitwit Villagers** a fitting makeover, making them look exactly how they act.

### ✨ Features

* 🟢 Gives Nitwit Villagers a unique, goofy appearance.
* 😂 Makes them instantly recognizable at a glance.
* 🎨 Fits naturally into Minecraft's vanilla art style.


> Because if they're not going to be helpful, they might as well be honest about it.
